description: This is a PHP source file defining the AdminSectionForm class, which extends an abstract form processor and manages a form related to administrative section configurations in the Goteo project. It includes methods for creating the form, defining constraints, saving form data, and handling image uploads.

classes.name: AdminSectionForm
classes.description: Form handler for admin section configuration, enabling creation, validation, and saving of form data including image uploads.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Defines validation constraints for the form, requiring that certain fields are not blank.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for section, title, description, button text, and image, based on the current model state.

methods.name: getChoices
methods.description: Generates a key-value pair array for choices in select fields, based on provided items.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes form submission data, handles image processing, rebuilds model data, and saves it, throwing exceptions on errors.
